# ORGEL Sustainability Report Index

> A free, continuously updated index of the latest sustainability report (also called an ESG, impact or corporate responsibility report) from every S&P 500 company. Each entry gives the company, ticker, sector, report name, report year, a direct link to the report, and a link to the company's sustainability page. Published by ORGEL, a Dallas, Texas sustainability research and advisory firm.

## Facts

- Coverage: every company in the S&P 500, plus every company that has left the S&P 500 since the index began. A company is added when it joins and is never removed, so the index lists more than 500 companies. The data does not mark which companies are current members.
- Accuracy: every link is traced to the company's own disclosure page, every entry is rechecked twice a week, and new reports are confirmed by a person before they are published.
- Scope: each company's latest report only. The reports themselves are not hosted here; each link goes to the report where the company published it.
- Cost: free. No key and no sign-up.

## Pages

- [Report Index](https://reports.orgel.us/): the searchable table, with a filter by sector.
- [Data & API](https://reports.orgel.us/developers): JSON, CSV and feed access, field descriptions, limits and terms.

## Data

- [Whole index as one file (JSON)](https://reports.orgel.us/data.json): one record per company.
- [Last update time and counts (JSON)](https://reports.orgel.us/meta.json)
- [Report changes, newest first (JSON)](https://reports.orgel.us/changes.json)
- [Newly published reports (Atom feed)](https://reports.orgel.us/feed.xml)
- CSV and filtered JSON for people's own tools are described on the Data & API page.

## Terms

The index itself (company, ticker, sector, report name, year and the links) is free for any use, commercial or not, under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license (CC BY 4.0). Credit is required: use a line such as "Source: ORGEL Sustainability Report Index, reports.orgel.us". The reports the links point to belong to the companies that published them. The data is offered as-is; verify anything you rely on against the company's document.

## Publisher

- [ORGEL](https://www.orgel.us/): sustainability research and advisory, Dallas, Texas.
- [ORGEL BLOG](https://www.orgel.us/blog): a new article every Tuesday.
